content: Native cloud-drive integrations (Dropbox, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion) consistently expose a Settings>Integrations connected-account card: OAuth-only connect (no API keys), approve on provider consent screen, status Connected/Revoked/Expired, reconnect and disconnect that immediately revokes token. Scoped least-privilege access; personal vs workspace-owned connections; secure token proxy/vault keeps tokens away from app logic/LLM. Disconnect removes local record and upstream grant.
